summary: This tutorial covers basic text alignment and formatting in LibreOffice Writer, specifically using GNU/Linux OS and version 334. It explains how to align text to the left, right, or justify it across the page edges. The tutorial also demonstrates how to add bullets and numbering for points in a document, which helps differentiate between them. To apply these features, one selects the desired text, clicks on the formatting options, and then chooses bullets and numbering from the menu. The tutorial shows how to change the numbering style and indent text using tab and shift keys. Additionally, it teaches how to copy and paste text within the document using the Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V shortcuts, demonstrating this by copying the "name" and "mother's name" fields and pasting them into the document.
